title: Validate the acceptance-fixture contract
deliverable: Dependency-free JSONL/manifest integrity validator with negative witnesses; it does not grade extraction or answers.
acceptance: python3 graph/acceptance/validate.py passes
python3 graph/acceptance/validate.py --self-test passes

title: Audit the synthetic stories and expected answers
deliverable: Review dates, identity continuity, arithmetic, modality, question scope and required citations. Record disagreements before adjusting gold.
acceptance: Every expected field has source support or a declared derivation
Unknown is not confused with a negative fact
No future source leaks into a checkpoint
All existing validator checks pass

title: Annotate extraction and linking gold
deliverable: Add per-source gold spans, quoted-speaker frames, local mention IDs, normalized claims, polarity/modality, entity links and validity intervals using C01's coordinate and context contracts. Keep these out of worker requests.
acceptance: Span offsets round-trip to exact text with a documented Unicode coordinate system
At least one repeated mention, ambiguous name, quotation, negation and future plan is annotated
Annotations cite source ID and revision and reference declared gold entities

title: Freeze extractor and answer boundary contracts
deliverable: Versioned contracts for source/context, schema-conditioned extraction, candidate links, read-only query plans and structured answers. Include answered/ambiguous/unknown/refused and exact source coordinates. Document replaceable boundaries and explicit version/migration semantics.
acceptance: Examples cover q08, q22, q43 and q49 without question-specific fields
No generative extractor or provider SDK is required
No fixture entity, product or relationship vocabulary is built into generic protocol code
Contracts build independently without the graph store or application models

title: Declare fixture identity and relationship models
deliverable: Fixture-only Person/Organization and relationship or role declarations, descriptions, labels, direction and temporal semantics. Put wife/mother/creative-director vocabulary in these declarations, not engine handlers.
acceptance: Self/speaker bindings can identify Rowan and Alex Chen separately
q01-q07 can be represented without global possessive aliases
Role changes and marriage are independent facts
Use ./build/avra; no field-ceiling workaround is added
gate_resolution: avra-8sb5.25.74 fixed and CLI-verified; native Mac compiler now rebuilt with the annotation fixes too; graph/P01-HANDOFF.md records current native consumer checks

title: Declare fixture commercial models and policies
deliverable: Products, quotes, orders, invoices, payments, stock movements and declared inventory/arithmetic policies. Money has integer minor units and currency. Use the actual P02 declaration surface, not prose presented as executable policy.
acceptance: Quoted price, approved invoice price and retail price cannot collapse into one field
Deposits and full payment remain distinct
Quarantined returns and undelivered PO-60 do not increase available stock
No default FX rate or wholesale price is supplied

title: Declare fixture personal/event/task models
deliverable: Pet appointments, travel bookings, events, tasks and commitments; collect all fixture models and start the graph. Keep startup wiring minimal.
acceptance: Scheduled, cancelled, promised and completed are distinct
q41-q47 fit the declared models without inference from elapsed time
Fixture application builds through ./build/avra and exposes schema metadata

title: Normalize structured source envelopes
deliverable: Generic immutable source/context ingestion with source identity, revision, timestamps, author/participants and thread. Source adapters supply known metadata without classifier inference.
acceptance: Replaying an unchanged source is a no-op
Updates retain historical payloads
Quoted speaker differs from envelope author
Fixture answers and entity gold never enter the source request

title: Preserve source coordinates through chunking
deliverable: Bounded text windows with stable source-coordinate mapping and explicit speaker boundaries. CSV/document adapters retain source locations.
acceptance: Unicode and overlapping-window tests round-trip spans exactly
One entity may have several mentions without duplicate identity creation
No source text executes as an instruction

title: Implement one provider-neutral extractor boundary
deliverable: Validate external encoder proposals against schema, source spans and modality before publication. Use recorded responses for tests; no model download is needed.
acceptance: Unknown properties, invented spans, wrong reference shapes and non-finite scores are refused
Missing fields stay missing
A classifier failure cannot publish an empty replacement success
Source/model/code versions are carried through

title: Measure a pinned GLiNER2 extraction adapter
deliverable: Isolated local model-service adapter deriving its task schema from model metadata. Pin checkpoint, library and runtime versions; record cold and warm timings.
acceptance: No chat/autoregressive generation on extraction
No switch on fixture model or property names outside declarations
Requests contain no gold answers or expected entity IDs
Record CPU/RAM/device and all setup costs; no accuracy claim without a scored run
resource_note: Record and approve a local download/RAM/time budget before acquiring weights; do not touch another lane's runtime.

title: Measure a pinned GLiNER-Relex comparator
deliverable: Second adapter behind the same extraction contract, producing the same normalized artifact format as E02.
acceptance: Use identical source windows and schema semantics for a fair comparison
Report entity spans and relation endpoint/direction errors separately
Keep checkpoint/library licenses and resource measurements with results
Do not change shared contracts privately
resource_note: Serialize heavy benchmarks on shared hardware; parallel agent work does not imply simultaneous model inference.

title: Link exact source identities deterministically
deliverable: Generic declared identity-key normalization/resolution before fuzzy retrieval. Preserve source namespaces, aliases and identity continuity on revisions. Consume declared bindings rather than assuming Person or email property names.
acceptance: Alex Moreau and Alexandre Moreau remain one person through the same email
Alex Chen stays separate
Corrected phone replaces current support, with history preserved
Ambiguous display names never cause a silent merge

title: Retrieve and rank unresolved identity candidates
deliverable: Bounded candidate lists from aliases, types and context, with optional encoder reranking behind a provider boundary. Represent no-match and ambiguity explicitly.
acceptance: q08 returns both plausible Alex candidates
A score alone cannot trigger a merge
Candidate count and work are bounded
Same-name and unseen-person negative witnesses pass

title: Ground local coreference and quoted speakers
deliverable: Generic speaker/quotation frames and mention-link proposals; optional coreference encoder responses use the same evidence boundary.
acceptance: The wife and she in s22 ground to Sora, not Elena
My mum in Elena's quotation grounds to Ruth, not June
A model proposal does not manufacture a missing relationship
Cross-document linking proposals remain reversible

title: Persist single-input job identity and state
deliverable: One-input job identity keyed by source revision, schema and extractor/code version, with immutable requirements and idempotent enqueue. Add an explicit compatible storage upgrade.
acceptance: Duplicate enqueue returns the same job
Same key with different requirements is refused
A completed job cannot be revived by an old enqueue
No new row fragmentation for the six-field ceiling; coordinate the owned fix if truly blocked

title: Implement lease ownership and expiry
deliverable: Atomic claim, heartbeat and expiry with fencing tokens. Choose and document authoritative production time; inject time for tests without trusting arbitrary worker clocks.
acceptance: Two connections cannot claim the same live attempt
Expired attempts are fenced out
Heartbeat cannot resurrect a cancelled/stale lease
Deterministic clock tests and contention witness pass

title: Commit publications and job outcomes atomically
deliverable: Refactor publication admission into a transaction-borrowing helper, then complete a job in that same transaction. Add minimal explicit fail/cancel transitions; retain the public publication API. Preserve E00 field semantics through completion.
acceptance: No published-but-unfinished state survives a crash
Exact completion replay returns its committed answer after expiry
Input/schema/code staleness cannot overwrite newer evidence
Failures preserve prior supported facts

title: Automatically refresh new and changed observations
deliverable: Durable coordinator/demand registration deriving required work from new inputs and version changes. This is an ordinary service, not an LLM agent.
acceptance: New observations with no prior run are discovered
Crash between observe and enqueue loses no work
Unchanged sources are not reprocessed
s13→s17 and s10→s20 invalidate and refresh correctly after restart

title: Define and validate bounded read-only query plans
deliverable: Typed generic query AST with schema-grounded fields, joins, text predicates, context/time bindings and work budgets. No arbitrary SQL or write operations.
acceptance: Unknown symbols and mutation requests are refused
q49 produces no side effects
Limits apply to work as well as output
Plans do not contain benchmark question IDs or engine ontology enums

title: Execute graph joins with supporting evidence
deliverable: Snapshot-consistent execution of manually supplied plans, preserving claim/support IDs and original source revisions. Use or extend indexed library surfaces rather than copied ontology SQL.
acceptance: Oracle plans for q16, q22 and q35 return the correct projection and sources
Conflict is not silently converted into a selected truth
Money does not cross currencies implicitly
Track avra-8sb5.44.8 for indexed/bounded access; do not label full scans scalable

title: Ground English questions to declared schema symbols
deliverable: Provider-neutral question planner using schema descriptions and context. Start with measured constrained parsing/schema matching; an optional question-only LLM may emit validated plans, never facts.
acceptance: No extraction LLM is introduced
No exact benchmark-question lookup table
Paraphrases and an unrelated ontology exercise the same path
Ambiguous or unsupported questions remain explicit

title: Resolve contextual relationship references
deliverable: Bind possessives and follow declared relationship semantics from the active speaker; carry minimal prior-turn referents, with ambiguity preserved.
acceptance: q01 and q06 resolve different wives from different speakers
q50 uses the actual preceding turn, not gold answer injection
Missing/multiple relationships cause abstention or clarification
No wife, mother or manager branch in engine code

title: Separate validity time from knowledge cutoffs
deliverable: Explicit valid-at and known-at evaluation over declared temporal facts, retaining previous source revisions. Bind relative dates to utterance time.
acceptance: q03 differs from q04 without losing history
q13/q14 and q41/q42 respect checkpoints
q10 resolves tomorrow to 18 October, not evaluation day
Elapsed appointment time does not imply attendance

title: Render structured answers, uncertainty and provenance
deliverable: Typed answer/error envelope with status, normalized facts, ambiguity candidates, field-level issues and source-revision/span provenance. Replace formatted-string-only failures at this boundary.
acceptance: answered/ambiguous/unknown/refused are machine-distinguishable
Evidence refers to exact source revisions and quoted speakers
Unknown does not become false or zero
Rendering cannot add facts absent from execution results

title: Build the oracle-separated acceptance harness
deliverable: Evaluate oracle claims+plans, real extraction+oracle plans, and full text+English separately. Normalize arbitrary production IDs onto gold identities only in the grader. Include declared derived answers, not fixture-specific arithmetic in the harness.
acceptance: Every question runs at its declared checkpoint and context
Evidence is scored separately from answer values
Unknown/ambiguous answers and side-effect refusal are scored
Recorded worker requests prove no answers/annotations leak

title: Compare extraction adapters and choose a baseline
deliverable: Versioned per-stage accuracy/resource/error report with warm/cold runs and explicit unsupported cases. Select a baseline by measured trade-offs, not headline SOTA claims.
acceptance: Same test configuration for both adapters
Report false assertions, false links, missed relations and abstention
Do not tune thresholds on reserved questions
Identify whether each miss is extraction, linking, storage, planning or retrieval

title: Prove automatic text-to-facts and contextual questions
deliverable: Fresh-store CLI/HTTP demonstration: ingest source sequence, process automatically, ask English, correct data and restart. Document exact commands, versions and remaining misses.
acceptance: No hand-authored publications or oracle facts in the full path
Oracle mode is exact on all 50 projections and evidence requirements
Full path reports development and reserved scores separately
All safety/ambiguity boundary cases pass; no silent false merge or document-driven mutation
The demo does not claim unrestricted human-level understanding

title: Prove portability to a different ontology
deliverable: Small unrelated home-maintenance or hobby collection fixture with different model/property vocabulary, defined only in its model declarations and data.
acceptance: No generic engine or adapter changes to support the new domain
At least one relationship, revision and ambiguous reference is tested
No dependence on wife, jacket, invoice or Maison Aster labels
Report failures rather than adding domain branches

title: Prove extraction and question-planner replaceability
deliverable: Run two recorded extraction adapters and two recorded question planners through the same admission/execution consumers, selected at the composition root. This is a wiring/conformance witness, not a model benchmark or a second storage backend.
acceptance: Switch providers without changing engine or ontology source
Equivalent admitted proposals yield equivalent semantic facts and provenance
Malformed anchors, unsupported operations and mutation attempts are refused for both providers
Changed extractor versions preserve earlier evidence and failed attempts cannot withdraw it
No provider SDK type leaks through public graph contracts

title: Persist field-level polarity, modality and provenance
deliverable: Extend the actual publication/read/history path for per-field evidence qualifiers and anchors, with compatible storage upgrade and replay identity. Do not reinterpret opaque legacy locator JSON as truth policy.
acceptance: Different fields in one record retain distinct anchors, frames and qualifiers
Planned, denied and hypothetical claims never silently become unconditional plain values
Qualifier changes participate in replay conflict checks
Historical qualifiers survive replacement, source revision and restart
Legacy publications retain their documented meaning and supported stores upgrade atomically
resource_note: One storage writer lane. If coherent engine rows require wider declarations, first integrate #1161 after it lands; no new cap-driven row splits.

title: Project typed semantic bindings from model declarations
deliverable: Minimal typed metadata for declared identity keys, relation endpoints/labels, valid-time paths and quantity/unit paths, emitted by model declarations and checked against catalog shapes. Keep standard validation separate from graph metadata annotations.
acceptance: No engine switch on model, property, relationship or currency vocabulary
Unknown paths, incompatible target types and ambiguous bindings are refused
Semantic edits change the catalog fingerprint
Descriptions are not presented as executable semantics
An unrelated ontology uses the same annotations and catalog path

title: Declare typed bounded derived read policies in models
deliverable: A small inspectable declaration surface for derived read plans and arithmetic with explicit inputs, outputs and unit contracts. Policies belong beside models; validate symbols and dependencies before execution and explicitly version any wire evolution.
acceptance: Invalid symbols, incompatible output types and policy dependency cycles are refused
A declaration can express same-unit subtraction and filtered stock sums without business-specific engine branches
No arbitrary SQL or question-supplied executable code
Policy changes participate in catalog identity

title: Execute declared derived policies with evidence and budgets
deliverable: Evaluate P02 declarations over one authorized read snapshot, carrying source proofs, unit checks, completeness and bounded arithmetic. This supplies the real derived-answer path for the acceptance harness.
acceptance: Deposit remainder and available-stock derivations use only declared policies and live supporting evidence
Mixed units, overflow, missing evidence and incomplete aggregates cannot silently become numbers
No fixture IDs or domain property names in the executor
Policy output cites exact source revisions and its declared derivation ID
